purpose: Response-blind schema qualification from NOAA official ISO metadata after Texas v1 ended at metadata transport with zero biological response access.
required_before_any_response_access: focal species or species field semantics
explicit interpretation of zero/absence/missing sufficient to define recorded loss
one exact official response-file or archive identity

frozen_endpoint.source_eligibility: source-year unit has recorded focal seagrass presence
frozen_endpoint.target: same stable unit in immediately following calendar year
frozen_endpoint.recorded_loss: target-year focal species is explicitly surveyed and recorded absent/zero under official semantics
frozen_endpoint.recorded_persistence: target-year focal species remains explicitly recorded present

no_rescue: Do not follow any data/archive URL in this gate.
Do not infer absence from missing rows or missing measurements.
Do not select focal species using outcome performance.
Do not alter the endpoint after any raw response value is opened.
